subject: Error on deployment unable to load shared object

messages.author: c40d2469f7cdd6b5
messages.subject: Error on deployment unable to load shared object
parts:
I had a package called 'treemap' installed and it deployed perfectly fine a few weeks ago. When I went to redeploy the application today, rsconnect deployed the application successfully but the server displays the following error: 

Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) :
unable to load shared object '/opt/R/3.3.2/lib/R/library/igraph/libs/igraph.so':
libRlapack.so: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
Error in value[[3L]](cond) : package or namespace load failed for ‘treemap’
Calls: local ... tryCatch -> tryCatchList -> tryCatchOne -> <Anonymous>
Execution halted

I have the igraph library on RStudio and the dependency should have been picked up. 

Since this worked fine a few weeks ago I cannot pinpoint what settings might have changed. I did install a separate (unrelated?) library for testing purposes using devtools:install_local() for testing purposes and finally to deploy it I installed it using devtools::install_github() from my personal repository. Could this have changed any settings in the background?

Everything works fine on my local machine.
